{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Convert revenue from string to float, handling commas
# First, replace commas and convert to float
data['revenue'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
qa_mask = data['revenue'] == 999999.99
print(f"Number of QA orders removed: {qa_mask.sum()}")

# Remove QA orders
data = data[~qa_mask]

# Filter to only completed checkouts (converted = 1)
converted_data = data[data['converted'] == 1]

# Check the number of converted orders
print(f"Number of converted orders (completed checkouts): {len(converted_data)}")

# Check distribution of channels and customer segments
print("\nChannel distribution among converted orders:\n", converted_data['channel'].value_counts())
print("\nCustomer segment distribution among converted orders:\n", converted_data['customer_segment'].value_counts())

# Check for refunded orders in converted data
print("\nRefunded orders in converted data (should be 0):", (converted_data['status'] == 'refunded').sum())

# Check if any converted orders have revenue == 0
print("\nConverted orders with revenue == 0:", (converted_data['revenue'] == 0).sum())"}
